subject.title: [Feature]: Add one-way dispatch mode for A2A handoffs without reply-back ping-pong

question: Should one-way A2A handoff be added as a `sessions_send` mode, a separate one-way primitive, or declined while keeping only the current conversation lifecycle?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear in source, but the fix changes model-facing session semantics and can affect existing peer A2A workflows, so automation should not choose the permanent API shape.

options.title: Add explicit dispatch mode
options.body: Extend `sessions_send` with an explicit one-way mode while preserving current conversation behavior as the default and covering both modes in docs/tests.

options.title: Create a separate primitive
options.body: Add a `sessions_deliver` or `sessions_enqueue` style tool so dispatch cannot be confused with conversational `sessions_send`, at the cost of another tool surface.

options.title: Keep current lifecycle only
options.body: Treat reverse-call and announce issues as narrower bugs and defer or decline a new one-way core API until a broader A2A design is accepted.

recommendation.title: Add explicit dispatch mode
recommendation.body: Extend `sessions_send` with an explicit one-way mode while preserving current conversation behavior as the default and covering both modes in docs/tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history points to steipete as the strongest routing candidate for the sessions_send A2A lifecycle and docs contract.
